theme_and_context.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST variant tailored for enterprise dashboard
theme_and_context.description: Functional beauty, dense compact spacing, high-contrast readability, clear interaction states. The design preserves the existing clean Stone, Emerald, Violet, and Sky palettes already established in the dashboard.

typography.headings: System default clean sans-serif (Inter/Geist) to match existing design. Preserve classes like text-stone-900, font-semibold.
typography.body: text-sm text-stone-500, text-stone-600, or text-stone-800 for maximum data density and legibility.
typography.hierarchy: Strict text sizes: max text-4xl for page titles (like 'Supplier rankings'), text-base/text-sm for card titles and data.

colors.primary_brand: Emerald (emerald-600/700) for ESG/Emissions, Sky/Teal for Documents, Violet for GHG, Amber for Training

visual_enhancers.borders: border-stone-200 for standard structural cards, border-stone-100 for internal dividers
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for interactive overlays/dialogs, shadow-none for flat dashboard cards
visual_enhancers.corner_radius: rounded-lg for main containers, rounded-md for nested inner elements
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy medical/finance/assessment areas to prevent visual refraction of data; use solid off-white/stone backgrounds for dialogs.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-5), grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2 for chart comparisons, 1fr for full-width tabular data.
layouts_and_grids.card_structure: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows.

SupplierRanking.jsx: In the ESG Tab (`TabsContent value='esg'`), LOCATE the `Card` with `data-testid='esg-module-coverage-card'` ('Assessment module coverage (avg completion)') and REMOVE it.
In its place (or alongside the ESG score distribution), ADD a new `Card` with `data-testid='esg-supplier-comparison-card'` displaying a grouped bar chart of each supplier's E, S, and G scores.
Use Recharts `BarChart` for the grouped chart. Map over the `esg` array (which contains suppliers with esg scores).

Configure `<XAxis dataKey='company_name' />` and three `<Bar>` components: `environment_score` (color: #059669 / emerald-600), `social_score` (color: #3b82f6 / blue-500), and `governance_score` (color: #7c3aed / violet-600).
SupplierDocumentsAdmin.jsx: In the list of published agreements (`published-supplier-agreements-list`), REPLACE the inline wrapping list of individual supplier badges (`agreement-assigned-suppliers-...`) with a scalable summary text (e.g., '25 suppliers assigned').

ADD a 'View suppliers' link or button next to the summary that triggers a dialog (or modify the existing 'Responses' dialog) containing a table/list of all assigned suppliers with their 'Pending' or 'Submitted' statuses.
ADD a 'Preview Document' button to each document in the main list. Clicking it must trigger a secure in-app preview (e.g., a modal with an iframe or secure object tag for PDF/DOC viewing).
SupplierTrainingAdmin.jsx: In the training list (`training-admin-list`), ADD a 'Preview Training' button to each training item so the parent organization can securely preview the uploaded training content in read-only mode.
The preview should open an in-app dialog overlay containing a secure viewer (video, audio, or document viewer depending on file type).
Ensure the preview action strictly maintains read-only access.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Preserve existing styles, spacing (Tailwind classes), and Shadcn UI component usage.
Do not break Recharts responsive containers; ensure all Recharts elements have correct imports from 'recharts'.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text or critical UI. All dropdowns, dialogs, and tooltips must have solid backgrounds.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case to facilitate robust automated testing.
Ensure accessible contrast for all text over chart colors.
Use optical alignment for buttons with icons, adding slightly more padding to the side without the icon.
